modules.name: Fixture Item Lookup
modules.purpose: Represent only the read-only API and UI observations required by the frozen Phase 6 fixture smoke baseline.
function_names: Retrieve the fixture item by its fixed id
Render the loaded item name and status in the fixture UI

business_objects.name: Fixture Item
business_objects.business_purpose: A static item returned by the isolated smoke fixture so the API response and UI rendering can be observed.
business_objects.stable_identity: The fixture item identifier is the string "1" in the frozen baseline.

events.name: Read fixture item through API
events.trigger: The smoke Case sends GET /api/items/1 to the isolated fixture.
preconditions: The isolated fixture endpoint is reachable for the later formal run.
outputs: HTTP 200 and the exact JSON object {"id":"1","name":"Smoke item","status":"ready"}.
must_not_change: The read-only smoke action must not mutate fixture business data.
failure_conditions: The endpoint is unavailable, does not return HTTP 200, or returns a body different from the frozen baseline.
failure_final_facts: The Case result is unresolved until the response can be compared with the frozen expected object; this model does not classify infrastructure failure as a product defect.

events.name: Load and display fixture item
events.trigger: A smoke user clicks the Load item button in the isolated fixture UI.
preconditions: The fixture page exposes the Item lookup heading and Load item button.
outputs: The visible #result text is exactly Smoke item — ready.
must_not_change: No persistence, mutation, or durable post-refresh behavior is asserted by this fixture baseline.
failure_conditions: The expected heading or button is absent, or the visible result does not equal the frozen baseline.
failure_final_facts: The visible-result assertion is unresolved until observed; no claim about persistent state follows from the UI smoke.

unknowns.question: Do these fixture observations represent the real business meaning, lifecycle, permissions, and persistence expectations of an actual product?
unknowns.why_needed: Those expectations cannot be inferred from the isolated fixture and must not be presented as confirmed business requirements.
unknowns.impact_summary: This uncertainty blocks using the model as confirmed requirements for a real business project, but is explicitly outside the read-only fixture smoke scope.

dimensions.reason: This Run models read-only fixture lookups only; no create, edit, or delete behavior is in scope.
The fixture exposes only a fixed ready snapshot; no transition or state-changing operation is in scope.
The fixture baseline declares no relationships and the two lookup observations do not create or maintain associations.
The modeled operations are read-only observations with no business writes to make atomic.
No state-changing business operation or recovery behavior is asserted by the fixture smoke.
The acceptance baseline asserts the current response and rendered value only, not historical facts.
This isolated local fixture has no authorization expectation in the frozen acceptance scope; real authorization remains out of scope.
The baseline contains no asynchronous workflow, retry contract, or idempotency expectation.
The fixture smoke comprises isolated lookup observations, not a multi-step business journey.
Only one fixture module is in scope and no downstream module behavior is asserted.
The acceptance baseline has no concurrent updates or stale-write behavior.
The fixed identifier is used to locate one fixture baseline item; no uniqueness or reuse rule is asserted.

self_review.review_boundary: Self-review covers structural completeness and consistency of this fixture/test baseline model only. It is not user confirmation or evidence of real business correctness.
